ev.q: Among these five persons, only the index patient exhibited symptoms consistent with cutaneous anthrax
LF concentration was 11.9 ng/mL in the acute serum sample

changes.why: The acute vs convalescent fourfold anti-PA rise is a laboratory criterion that confirms case status for one patient, not a comparison of public health outcomes; CBC values against reference ranges are clinical.
With the seroconversion criterion treated as case confirmation, the single-case report makes no group, period or referent comparison of outcomes.

equity.level_reason: Age and sex of the single patient are descriptors only, with no social-position framing; ranching is a route of exposure, not SES.

notes: Brief rule: a lab test that only confirms case status is not a procedure; by the same logic the paired-sera rise is not treated as an analytic comparison.
